asm.range: The value must be between {{min}} and {{max}}
asm.targetRange: The target is too far away (offset must be between {{min}} and {{max}})
asm.targetAlign: The target must be a multiple of 4
asm.jumpRegion: call and jmpi reach only targets in the same 256 MB region as the instruction; use callr or jmp
asm.controlNotAllowed: "{{name}}" is not a general-purpose register here
asm.customNotAllowed: "{{name}}" is a custom register; only the custom instruction takes it
asm.expectedControl: Expected a control register (status, ienable, ctl5, ...)
asm.jmpRa: r31 cannot be used with jmp; use ret instead

halt.misalignedFetch: The program counter {{pc}} is not a multiple of 4
halt.misalignedJump: Jump at {{pc}} to {{target}}, which is not a multiple of 4
halt.shadow: rdprs / wrprs at {{pc}}: this core has no shadow register sets
halt.customDone: The custom instruction at {{pc}} waits for done, but the done input is not 0 or 1
halt.customResult: The custom instruction at {{pc}} writes {{reg}}, but the result input is not a 32-bit value (an open or undefined bit)
